name: taskly-video
description: Taskly's 30-second motion design video, built with Remotion.

scripts.render: npm run render:landscape && npm run render:vertical
scripts.render:landscape: remotion render TasklyPromoFR ../site/assets/taskly-30s-fr.mp4 && remotion render TasklyPromoEN ../site/assets/taskly-30s-en.mp4
scripts.render:vertical: remotion render TasklyPromoFR-Vertical ../site/assets/taskly-30s-fr-vertical.mp4 && remotion render TasklyPromoEN-Vertical ../site/assets/taskly-30s-en-vertical.mp4
